description:
Nobleman Park Hyowon is no stranger to the pleasures of the flesh. If anything, he’s actually quite experienced. So when a friend mentions an oh-so-secret sex toy workshop, Hyowon’s interest is thoroughly piqued. But the coarse Shinwoo is nothing like the refined artisan Hyowon expected, and he finds himself drawn in by the man’s almost rude nature. So much so, that he’s determined to get past that rough exterior, and what better way than by targeting his pride? Accusing Shinwoo of lacking confidence in his products, Hyowon demands a hands-on demonstration, and soon gets much more than he bargained for when Shinwoo shows him pleasure he could never have imagined. There’s just one thing Hyowon can’t figure out. Just how much of his pleasure is caused by the art…and how much by the artisan? 

(Source: Lezhin US)
